subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed issue remain the coordination issue for both delivery-mirror side-branch poisoning and empty signed Anthropic thinking replay, or should maintainers split/close it under the narrower existing canonical items?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans separate but interacting session-replay paths with active open PRs, and choosing the canonical tracking shape is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a safe new repair job.

options.title: Coordinate Existing Threads
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror and Anthropic replay PRs, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Move the signed-thinking portion to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Request Sanitized Fixture
options.body: Ask the reporter for redacted JSONL/log excerpts before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing Threads
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror and Anthropic replay PRs, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is cross-cutting session/provider replay coordination, and current local history routes the central files to Peter Steinberger as the best available owner signal.
